Yes, that model is right. Each bookmark can have one offline copy, with the app automatically saving either a self-contained page file or the original PDF as appropriate. Removing it and saving again is enough if I ever want a fresh copy.

Internet Archive submission should remain a separate, manual action; I wouldn’t want every private save submitted publicly. The returned public snapshot link is useful.

Per-bookmark actions are enough for both features. I don’t need bulk offline capture or bulk Archive submission.
